research.hook: Harsh truth: 80 % of students think a revision plan is enough, but if your phone is still buzzing, you’re only studying at 30 % efficiency.
research.tip: Create a Phone‑Proof Revision Block: pick a 45‑minute slot, lock your phone in a box or set Airplane Mode, use a kitchen timer, study with paper notes only, then allow a 5‑minute phone check before the next block.

data.title_en: How to Build a Phone-Proof Revision Timetable

scenes.text: Harsh truth: phone paas ho toh JEE revision hamesha fail hoga.
scenes.text_en: Harsh truth: if your phone is near, JEE revision will always fail.
scenes.text_hi: Harsh truth: phone पास हो तो revision हमेशा fail होगा।

scenes.text: Padhne baithte ho, aur ek notification saara focus tod deta hai.
scenes.text_en: You sit to study, and one notification breaks all your focus.
scenes.text_hi: पढ़ने बैठते हो, और एक notification सारा focus तोड़ देता है।

scenes.text: Galti tumhari nahi, bas revision block phone-proof nahi hai.
scenes.text_en: It is not your fault, your revision block is just not phone-proof.
scenes.text_hi: गलती तुम्हारी नहीं, बस revision block phone-proof नहीं है।

scenes.text: Ye video us JEE batchmate ko bhejo jo hamesha distracted rehta hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this video to that JEE batchmate who is always distracted.
scenes.text_hi: ये video उस batchmate को भेजो जो हमेशा distracted रहता है।

scenes.text: Iska simple solution hai: forty-five minute ka Phone-Proof Block.
scenes.text_en: Its simple solution is a forty-five minute Phone-Proof Block.
scenes.text_hi: इसका simple solution है: forty-five minute का Phone-Proof Block।

scenes.text: Pehle, phone ko airplane mode par daal kar door rakh do.
scenes.text_en: First, put your phone on airplane mode and keep it away.
scenes.text_hi: पहले, phone को airplane mode पर डालकर दूर रख दो।

scenes.text: Phir ek kitchen timer lagao aur sirf paper notes se padho.
scenes.text_en: Then set a kitchen timer and study using only paper notes.
scenes.text_hi: फिर एक kitchen timer लगाओ और सिर्फ paper notes से पढ़ो।

scenes.text: Research kehti hai spaced repetition cramming se behtar yaad rakhta hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests spaced repetition retains better compared to cramming.
scenes.text_hi: Research कहती है spaced repetition cramming से बेहतर याद रखता है।

scenes.text: Isliye topics ko ratne ke bajay alag-alag din revise karo.
scenes.text_en: So instead of cramming topics, revise them across different days.
scenes.text_hi: इसलिए topics को रटने के बजाय अलग-अलग दिन revise करो।

scenes.text: Har block ke baad paanch minute ka phone break lo.
scenes.text_en: After every block, take a five-minute phone break.
scenes.text_hi: हर block के बाद पांच minute का phone break लो।

scenes.text: Ab tumhara timetable phone-proof hai, distraction ka koi chance nahi. Abhi try karo aur apne JEE friends ko tag karo!
scenes.text_en: Now your timetable is phone-proof, with zero chance for distraction. Try it now and tag your JEE friends!
scenes.text_hi: अब तुम्हारा timetable phone-proof है, distraction का कोई chance नहीं। अभी try करो और अपने JEE friends को tag करो!
